verdict.rationale: The pack shows no first-party analytics or reporting feature for call volume, answer rate, or missed calls per number or per teammate. The Call Log API is a developer building block that someone could use to compute these metrics, which earns no credit. The vague "insights" in the Call Queues Booster blurb never names these metrics or a per-number or per-teammate breakdown.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can see call volume, answer rate, and missed calls per number and per teammate
